statement: The call-cell reduce coordinator owns a bounded reclaim grammar: seedInvocation stamps the result row with its seed time so abandoned invocations are age-discriminable, reclaimExpiredCoordination deletes slot rows whose lease lapsed beyond a positive retention window plus result rows of invocations that never published a snapshot, published snapshots are never touched, and the invocation owner sweeps opportunistically once per new invocation (best-effort, never failing a live call) with the retention deployment-tunable through the bootstrap assembly — so coordination garbage from failed or abandoned invocations is bounded without a background reaper, and the call-cell-reduce-coordination-expiry scenario is green.
